kusaggenapi.g: etaṁ suraṁ vā merayaṁ vā bījato paṭṭhāya kusaggena pivatopi pācittiyanti attho.

kusaggenā.g: yathā kucchitabhāvena pūtibhūtaṁ macchaṁ kusatiṇaggena yo puriso upanayhati puṭabandhavasena bandhati, tassa te kusā apūtikāpi pūrimacchasambandhena pūti duggandhameva vāyanti.

kusaggena.g: yathā kucchitabhāvena pūtibhūtaṁ macchaṁ kusatiṇaggena yo puriso upanayhati puṭabandhavasena bandhati, tassa te kusā apūtikāpi pūrimacchasambandhena pūti duggandhameva vāyanti.

Kusaggenudakamādāya,.g: samma Kāḷahatthi yo kusaggeneva udakaṁ gahetvā “ettakaṁ siyā mahāsamudde udakan”ti tena saddhiṁ upamāya mineyya, so kevalaṁ mineyyeva, kusagge pana udakaṁ atiparittakameva.
